assertions: Actual root/context and registered source SAX/manifest owners produce original ZIP metadata records.
Independent inflate/CRC and native reopen validate emitted content in represented profiles.
record.capability: Original native package metadata entry output
gaps: Original native metadata entry writers retain actual package receiver/root/context, registered ManifestWriter/SAX Writer, generated property/pair sequences, ZipPackageBuffer, source CRC and ZipOutputEntry. Mimetype replacement/STORED/ASCII/error wrapping, native manifest rows and exact OFOPXML defaults/override selection are represented. Explicit aggregate value-initialization preserves std::make_unique semantics without changing default-initialized records. Full root commit/transfer/storage/factory/model/DOCX/XLSX UI acceptance and earlier owner coverage failures remain unfinished. Empty/legacy ManifestExport, native physical ABI/thread/allocation domains remain unqualified.

Original ConnectTo performs the throwing XSeekable query, input assignment and seek0, preserving existing ZipFile identity through setInputStream. A new reader uses original initialise=false and format-specific Checks, without rebuilding its catalog. Actual saved member streams read after output/rebind/replacement; a real nonseekable wrapper fails the original query. Main/DOM-free Worker observe identity and empty new-reader catalog. Debug ByteReader assertion remains unqualified.

stackDivergence.rationale: Represented original fields and generated UNO/RTL/native mutex owners use existing host storage while native physical ABI/allocator/thread and full package/stream services remain unqualified.
